notes: CD case looks like the real thing: disc under the cover, spine through the hinge, soft sheen and scuffs.

items: CD case looks like the real thing: the disc sits under the cover instead of peeking out beside it, the back insert’s spine shows through the hinge, and the plastic has a soft sheen, slight haze and faint scuffs instead of bright outlines.
Store pages: right-clicking the CD case no longer opens the CD Creator’s editing menu.

Convert: YouTube links work again. Compass gives the link tool its own built-in JavaScript runtime (YouTube now requires one), keeps the tool up to date weekly, and shows the real error instead of a warning.
Project pages are tighter so a full album fits on one screen without scrolling.

Artists: a song counts for the artist in its own Artist field, then the one in an "Artist - Song" title, and only then the project’s artist (folders don’t count). A song titled "Travis Scott - …" no longer counts as Latto just because it sits in a Latto project.
Artist page: All N songs shows every song counted for that artist, so you can check and fix them.
Reordering songs only animates the disc you’re moving them on; the other discs stay still.
Publish moves the project out of Projects: you get the digital album in Digital albums and the project in Archive. New version in Archive brings it back to work on.
Notifications now show at the bottom right, above the player.
Sidebar: CD Creator moved under Launcher.
Song lists: the Title header lines up with the track numbers.
Publish: when songs aren’t Final yet, hovering Publish says so and offers a Finalize button that marks them all Final.
Song menu is shorter: Move, Add to and Status open to the side on hover. Download is now Export.

Store pages: click an album for its own page: cover and CD panels (front, back, disc, back tray), the artist (opens their Store page), description, songs with 30-second previews, and Digital or CD. Picking CD shows the 3D case.

Publish: when every song is Final, Publish copies the project into a digital album and opens its Store settings: price (free is fine), number of copies or unlimited, CD and CD-upgrade prices, description, resale rules and wholesale packs. Your project stays editable.
Songs have a Type (Main, Bonus, Demo, Instrumental, Interlude) so bonus demos can be Final too.
Marketplace: Wholesale code packs (500, 1500, 5000, 10000) for shops and vendors. Each pack downloads as a CSV plus printable QR cards; every code works once and counts toward a limited edition.
Sidebar: the Compass logo next to Music Player, in Arial bold.
New name: Compass Music Player. The sidebar shows the Compass logo with Music Player.

Stats fit on one screen: totals in a compact strip, your most played songs, artists and projects side by side, and buttons to sort by plays, time listened or average per play. Click a row to play the song or open the project.
Fixed: the Artists tab was covered by a grey box when an artist had a project without a cover.
Library has an Archive tab. Archived projects are saved as they were and can't be edited; right-click one and choose New version to keep working on a copy.
Albums you own: a $ button on the album page sells it (when the artist allows resale). Lending moved into Share.
A lent album stays in your library with who has it and how long is left. Right-click it (or its ⋯) for Cancel lending or Adjust lending time.
Second-hand albums are now in the Marketplace instead of the Music Store.
Artist page: pick a colour for the artist's round picture and for the header (image button on the header). Or use one of their project covers as the picture or header.
Artist page is more compact: most played songs on the left (title only), projects and albums in a column on the right.
Logo: the W is gone. Compass is the disc on its own, in the app and as the Windows icon.
Every disc icon in the app is now the Compass disc.
